title: Personalized Reddit feeds show error "Not an RSS feed (553)"
summary: Reddit just made a change. Access to old.reddit.com does not seem to be possible anymore without logging in first. This includes RSS feeds… I can access https://www.reddit.com/r/ada/top/.rss?sort=top&t=week in the browser, but Newsblur shows Sorry, there was an unhandled error. Same for the personlized URL of that RSS feed. Edit: No clue what Reddit is doing, but one of my old.reddit.com feeds just got updated again…
body_markdown:
Reddit just made a change. Access to[old.reddit.com](http://old.reddit.com/) does not seem to be possible anymore without logging in first. This includes RSS feeds…


I can access[https://www.reddit.com/r/ada/top/.rss?sort=top&t=week](https://www.reddit.com/r/ada/top/.rss?sort=top&t=week) in the browser, but Newsblur shows


```text
Sorry, there was an unhandled error.


```


Same for the personlized URL of that RSS feed.


Edit: No clue what Reddit is doing, but one of my[old.reddit.com](http://old.reddit.com/) feeds just got updated again…
